question_text: A local government unit plans to cut the budget for public elementary schools in favor of building a new sports complex. Under Article XIV of the 1987 Constitution, which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: The LGU may reallocate funds because education is a local matter and the Constitution does not mandate specific funding levels.
The Constitution requires the state to protect and promote the right to quality education at all levels, and the state must assign the highest budgetary priority to education.
The Constitution only requires free elementary education but does not require any specific budget allocation.
The LGU can cut the education budget as long as it provides alternative funding from private sources.
